address: 56/8, 65/24 Mu 1, Thep Krasatti Road, Ko Kaeo, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: Grandma Chian opened this Hokkien restaurant in 1952. Her great-great grandchildren have stayed loyal to her recipes and proudly exhibit her cooking utensils. Serving Phuket favourites, the Mee Sapam, stir-fried Hokkien noodles with seafood, is great. The stir-fried oysters with crispy egg roll are beautifully crafted with beansprouts, kale and a tasty chilli sauce....
